Project.title: Project
Project.description: Construction engineering or metal fabrication project showcased in the public gallery and managed in the admin dashboard.

description.description: Engineering summary, materials, and scope of work.

category.description: Engineering service category for gallery filtering.

location.description: Project site city or industrial zone.

imageUrls.description: Ordered list of HTTPS download URLs, server media URLs, or compressed embedded WebP data URLs for project photographs.

storagePaths.description: Corresponding storage paths (Firebase Storage, local server, or external) for cleanup on deletion.

photoAppearance.description: Optional dashboard-configured visual presentation settings (aspect ratio, fit, focal point, frame style, tone, and adjustments) for project photographs.

authorId.description: UID of the administrator who created the project.

Testimonial.title: Testimonial
Testimonial.description: Client review managed by the business owner and displayed on the public website.

clientName.description: Full name of the client or project owner.

clientRole.description: Role and organization of the client.

projectType.description: Type of work delivered for this client.

quote.description: Verified customer feedback and outcome summary.

status.description: Display status on the public site.

authorId.description: UID of the administrator who created the testimonial.

Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: Customer quote or consultation inquiry submitted from the public contact form.

name.description: Full name of the prospective client.

message.description: Project scope, dimensions, and site details.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last status update.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized business administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

SiteProfile.title: SiteProfile
SiteProfile.description: Public engineer portrait, role title, headline, and practice description displayed on the About section and managed by administrators.

displayName.description: Principal engineer or practice lead display name.

description.description: Multi-paragraph practice biography and engineering background.

avatarUrl.description: HTTPS download URL, server media path, compressed WebP data URL, or empty string for default portrait.

avatarStoragePath.description: Storage path reference for cleanup on replacement.

phoneDisplay.description: Optional verified telephone number displayed on the public site.

whatsappNumber.description: Optional WhatsApp digits for direct chat link.

contactEmail.description: Optional public business inquiry email address.

workshopAddress.description: Optional genuine physical workshop or office street address.

cityRegion.description: Optional service region or county coverage in Kenya.

SiteImage.title: SiteImage
SiteImage.description: Custom admin-uploaded photograph for a specific public website visual slot (hero banner or service showcase card).

slot.description: Fixed visual slot identifier on the public website.

imageUrl.description: HTTPS download URL, server media path, or compressed WebP data URL.

storagePath.description: Storage path reference for cleanup on replacement.

caption.description: Optional custom alt/caption label for this visual slot.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Publicly readable (when status == published) and admin-managed construction engineering projects.

/testimonials/{testimonialId}.description: Publicly readable (when status == published) and admin-managed customer reviews.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: PII-isolated customer inquiries; public create-only with status == new, admin-only read/update/delete.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Authorized administrator directory; admin-only read and write.

/site_profile/{profileId}.description: Publicly readable single-document engineer profile and bio (/site_profile/main); admin-only write.

/site_images/{slotId}.description: Publicly readable admin-uploaded website showcase and hero photos keyed by fixed slot ID; admin-only write.
